# RDF-XML.ex v1.2.1 - Table of Contents

An implementation of RDF-XML for Elixir and RDF.ex.

## Pages

- [README](https://rdf-xml.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Change Log](https://rdf-xml.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [RDF.XML](https://rdf-xml.hexdocs.pm/RDF.XML.md): An implementation of the RDF 1.1 XML Syntax.
- [RDF.XML.Decoder](https://rdf-xml.hexdocs.pm/RDF.XML.Decoder.md): A decoder for RDF/XML serializations to `RDF.Graph`s.
- [RDF.XML.Encoder](https://rdf-xml.hexdocs.pm/RDF.XML.Encoder.md): An encoder for RDF/XML serializations of RDF.ex data structures.

- Exceptions
  - [RDF.XML.EncodeError](https://rdf-xml.hexdocs.pm/RDF.XML.EncodeError.md)
  - [RDF.XML.ParseError](https://rdf-xml.hexdocs.pm/RDF.XML.ParseError.md)
